name: webgis-claude-skills-agent-support
policy: Prefer a shared .agents/skills installation when the client supports the open Agent Skills layout; use native compatibility directories when the client has a separate discovery root.

codex.notes: Repository skills plus AGENTS.md remain separate concerns.

cursor.notes: Cursor also recognizes Claude and Codex compatibility directories.

opencode.notes: OpenCode discovers native and compatibility skill locations.

deepseek-harness.notes: Uses the portable Agent Skills location when the harness supports the standard. Native DeepSeek-specific discovery should be added only after verified documentation.
